gfm.label_source: Copernicus GFM ensemble flood extent (EODC archive)
gfm.label_method: GFM ensemble observed water (majority of 3 independent Sentinel-1 algorithms: DLR, LIST, TU Wien) AND NOT JRC GSW occurrence >= 50%; GFM exclusion mask -> no label. GFM's own flood extent (minus monthly reference water) kept as gfm_flood_extent
gfm.label_confidence: medium (automated operational product, not manually verified)

sen1floods11_hand.label_source: Sen1Floods11 v1.1 hand labels (Bonafilia et al. 2020)
sen1floods11_hand.label_method: Manual water delineation by analysts on S1 + S2 of the same day; flood = hand water AND NOT JRC GSW occurrence >= 50%
